objective: Evaluate capped-target intervals when calibration and evaluation endpoints follow the same sampling rule.
primary_scenario: One endpoint per engine, uniformly drawn from cycles 30..lifetime-1 of a complete simulated run-to-failure trajectory.
operational_scope: Retrospective randomized truncation, full 30-cycle history, no observed failure endpoint; NOT arbitrary real-time monitoring, short-history prediction or official external truncation.
novelty_limit: Data, held-out engines and prior calibration labels were previously examined. No confirmatory fresh-data claim; no repeated seed is an independent fleet.
training: Reuse original naive-MT checkpoints and training-only preprocessors. No retraining, refitting preprocessors, model selection or risk calibration.
partition: Within each saved 20% held-out engine set: SHA256 role ordering, floor(n/2) calibration and remaining evaluation. No model-training engine enters either group for that run.
endpoint_rng: PCG64 uniform seeded by first 16 hex digits of SHA256(domain|endpoint|subset|seed|engine); independent of group role.
secondary_scenario: Same calibration engines and uniforms, restricting calibration endpoints to raw RUL 1..125; the primary evaluation endpoints stay fixed. This is a paired sampling diagnostic, not the old official benchmark.
scores: Nonnegative max(q05-y,y-q95,0); normalized score divides by max(q95-q05,1e-6). Normalization power is fixed at 1.
rank: ceil((n_cal+1)*0.9); no interpolation; infinity if rank exceeds n_cal
projection: Project lower and upper endpoints separately to [0,125]; also save pre-projection membership and boundary additions.
reporting: Report every subset/seed/method, mean and sample SD across five seeds, paired restricted-vs-matched differences. No pooled independent-engine CI, significance test, selection of winner, stopping rule or reroll.
small_sample_limit: Only 10/26/10/25 calibration engines for FD001/2/3/4; quantile grid and empirical coverage are coarse. Matching the sampling rule does not prove exchangeability or guarantee empirical 90% in each run.
conditional_theory: A split-conformal marginal argument additionally needs exchangeability of held-out engine/endpoint pairs conditional on model fitting; this study neither tests nor proves that property.
